mapper.select: SELECT q.question_id, q.question_no, q.question_text, q.is_multiple, c.choice_id, c.choice_text, c.score, c.display_order FROM survey_questions q INNER JOIN survey_choices c ON c.question_id = q.question_id ORDER BY q.question_no ASC, c.display_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO survey_results ( user_id, answers_json, total_score, baseline, submitted_at, calculated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{answersJson}, #{totalScore}, #{baseline}, #{submittedAt}, #{calculatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT survey_result_id, user_id, answers_json, total_score, baseline, submitted_at, calculated_at, created_at FROM survey_results WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, survey_result_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO survey_result_interest ( survey_result_id, interest_id ) VALUES
(#{surveyResultId}, #{interestId})
mapper.select: SELECT i.interest_id, i.interest_name, i.is_investment, i.created_at FROM survey_result_interest sri INNER JOIN interests i ON i.interest_id = sri.interest_id WHERE sri.survey_result_id = #{surveyResultId} ORDER BY i.interest_id ASC
